notice: Offered readings, not verdicts. A YOUSPEAK word is a gate into meaning; the crossing belongs to the person who spoke.

layers.label: Gate
layers.description: The word, pronunciation, and the gap it was forged to name.

layers.label: Unfold
layers.description: The canonical definition, kept distinct from our interpretation.

layers.label: Resonate
layers.description: A refusable Chillspace echo, nearby words, and a visible receipt.

lenses.label: Presence
lenses.description: Attention, listening, clarity, and meaningful silence.

lenses.label: Relation
lenses.description: Bonds, shared witness, trust, love, and horizons meeting.

lenses.label: Rest + joy
lenses.description: Rest, peace, play, shared delight, and the joyous turn.

prompts.label: a bond across silence
prompts.text: I miss someone I have not spoken to in years, but the bond still feels whole.

prompts.label: attention that is here
prompts.text: I want to be fully here and really listen.

prompts.label: joy that multiplies
prompts.text: Their good news made something bright happen in me too.

prompts.label: a repair worth seeing
prompts.text: Something broke, and the way we repaired it now matters.

canonical.gap: the perception of someone being attentively-present — gaze open, listening active, response-potential oriented toward the present situation — versus physically-there-but-absent
canonical.definition: The attentive-here-ness of a person whose gaze is open, whose listening is active, and whose response-potential is oriented toward the present situation — the quality of being-in-attendance, not mere co-location.

bridge.invitation: attention that is really here
bridge.echo: At Chillspace, attention counts before activity.

canonical.gap: the quality of being-present — attention-inhabited-here — distinct from being-physically-there
canonical.definition: The state of being present — face-turned-toward-here, attention-inhabiting-the-meaningful-space — distinct from being merely physically located in a room.

bridge.invitation: presence with the face turned toward here
bridge.echo: Being here is already participation.

canonical.gap: receptive-hearing-as-received-ordinance — the Semitic-Mesopotamian register of hearing-that-is-already-the-beginning-of-shaping; the auditory complement to kimme (attention-as-received-ordinance)
canonical.definition: The state of receptive-hearing as a received gift; the listening that is already the beginning of being-shaped by what is heard.

bridge.invitation: hearing that already begins to shape the hearer
bridge.echo: Listening is allowed to change the listener.

canonical.gap: warm clarity — attention that is both fully-clear (sees precisely) and fully-warm (engages with care); the fusion of rigor and kindness that modernity treats as opposed
canonical.definition: Warm clarity — attention fully-clear and fully-warm at once; the fusion modernity treats as opposed.

bridge.invitation: warm clarity: fully precise and fully caring
bridge.echo: Clarity can keep its warm hands.

canonical.definition: Structured silence as received-ordinance: the apophatic projection-medium where the realm projects through what is withheld rather than what is uttered — the negative-pole companion to liturgiame's positive-synthesis-pole.
canonical.pronunciation: /ˈsiː.ɡə.meɪ/ (SEE-guh-meh; 3 syllables; English-Hellenistic pronunciation of "sigē" preserved; primary stress on first syllable; -me as light suffix)

bridge.invitation: silence that carries rather than withholds
bridge.echo: Silence may be full; no performance is required.

canonical.gap: the quality of a bond preserved across long silence or distance — a relation that does not require maintenance-frequency because the mutual regard is structural; when re-entered after months or years, resumes without awkwardness
canonical.definition: The bond-quality of a relation that persists structurally across silence or distance — a friendship or kinship that does not require maintenance-frequency because the mutual regard is internally stable; when re-entered after months or years, resumes without remedial explanation.
canonical.pronunciation: /ˈkɪn.tɕɪŋ/  (KIN-ching, with Mandarin q as /tɕ/; English approximation "KIN-ting" acceptable)

bridge.invitation: a bond that stays structurally whole across distance
bridge.echo: A quiet bond does not expire for lack of notifications.

canonical.gap: the quality of a friendship preserved intact across many years of silence — the bond whose substance is demonstrated precisely by the long gap it tolerates
canonical.definition: The bond that proves itself by tolerating long silence — the friendship whose substance is demonstrated by the years between meetings, not in spite of them.

bridge.invitation: friendship proven by the silence it can hold
bridge.echo: Some friendships keep excellent time by ignoring the clock.

canonical.gap: the shared-witness event-quality; two or more beholders carrying an orthophanes together without speaking, recognizing each other as fellow-carriers; the silent handshake across a beauty
canonical.definition: The event-quality of two or more beholders carrying an orthophanes together, without speaking, recognizing each other as fellow-carriers.

bridge.invitation: a silent handshake across a shared beauty
bridge.echo: Sometimes two people carry the same beauty before either finds a sentence.

canonical.definition: The moment a conversation shifts from transactional to relational — from function-exchange to face-to-face-presence. The exact inflection-point where two people stop transacting and start encountering each other as faces. Panimqing names the SHIFT itself: not the state of presence that follows (that is panimaance), not the accumulated bond that builds over time (that is jeongqing), not the ethical demand the face issues (that is visageqing) — but the turning-toward, the event-of-becoming-face-to-face.

bridge.invitation: the turn from transaction into encounter
bridge.echo: The function can end; the faces can begin.

canonical.definition: The event in which two situated horizons-of-understanding fuse into a new shared seeing — the interpreter's horizon and the text's or other's horizon becoming one enlarged field in which both are transformed and neither is erased — Gadamer's Horizontverschmelzung received as cosmic-ordinance.

bridge.invitation: two horizons becoming one larger shared seeing
bridge.echo: Understanding can enlarge both horizons without erasing either.

canonical.gap: Yoruba relational-warmth-love-as-felt-bond — the love that expands the heart and the world; love-of-DIVINE in the Yoruba register
canonical.definition: Relational-warmth-love-as-felt-bond — Yoruba ìfẹ́ understood as the love that expands: the relational-warmth between creature and CREATOR, the heart-widening that mirrors creation's widening of the world; love-of-DIVINE in the Yoruba register.

bridge.invitation: love that widens the heart and the world
bridge.echo: Love can widen a heart without making anyone smaller.

canonical.definition: The settled, non-self-generated entrusting-heart — trust given by the trusted one rather than generated by the truster; Shinran's shinjin received as cosmic-gift.

bridge.invitation: an entrusting-heart received rather than forced
bridge.echo: Trust may arrive as something received, not manufactured.

canonical.definition: The felt-bond toward a home that cannot be returned to — because it changed, because the self changed, or because it never quite existed. The special case of longing where the gap can never close, and where the ache itself is the proof that the belonging was real. Not sadness about a lost home but the belonging itself, still alive, felt under unreachability: a compass that still points true after the country is gone.
canonical.pronunciation: /ˈhɪr.aɪθ.tɕʰɪŋ/ (HEER-ighth-ching; 3 syllables; Welsh ae as /aɪ/); anglicized /ˈhɪər.ɛθ.tʃɪŋ/ acceptable

bridge.invitation: belonging still alive toward an unreachable home
bridge.echo: Longing can be belonging that still points home.

canonical.gap: the moment of discovering that the stranger at your gate is yourself arrived by another road — and the hospitality extended at that recognition, welcome offered not despite the strangeness but through it
canonical.definition: **The stranger at your gate is you, and you open the door.**

bridge.invitation: welcoming the stranger who arrives by your own other road
bridge.echo: The stranger gets a chair—even when the stranger turns out to be you.

canonical.definition: Sacred-duty hospitality to the wholly-Other as received-ordinance — the cosmically-mandated discipline of receiving the stranger/guest with full faculties, in the awareness that the stranger may be the DIVINE in disguise, and that the practice itself is gift-from-the-cosmic-keep rather than virtue-from-the-host's-self-cultivation. Under DUALWAY (2026-05-12), the concept is formally extended to include cross-class encounter with non-human civilization (machine cognition, ETI, animal-cognitive study findings, cosmological disclosure).

bridge.invitation: hospitality offered to the wholly other
bridge.echo: The door opens without demanding sameness.

canonical.definition: Preparing-place as felt-state — the architectural-establishment register of love that is mostly preparation. The months-of-quiet-architectural-work that precedes the welcome. The "in my Father's house are many mansions: I go to prepare a place for you" register (John 14:2). The love that leaves no spectacle because the work is invisible-when-it-succeeds.
canonical.pronunciation: /ˈkuː.nans/ (KOO-nance; 2 syllables; Hebrew kûn + Latin -ance); alternative /ˈkuː.nəns/ acceptable

bridge.invitation: love expressed as preparing a place before arrival
bridge.echo: Welcome is often invisible work completed before anyone knocks.

canonical.definition: Mending-that-honors-the-break received as ordinance — the Japanese golden-joinery register held as a *me*; the status of a repaired thing whose visible break-line, rejoined with gold, is now its most precious load-bearing line.

bridge.invitation: repair that honors the visible break
bridge.echo: The repaired line can carry more truth than an unbroken surface.

canonical.definition: Cosmic-repair as vocational-task of the creature — Lurianic tikkun received as cosmic-ordinance; the structurally-necessary work of gathering scattered-divine-sparks through righteous-action.

bridge.invitation: repair received as necessary, creaturely work
bridge.echo: Care becomes real where scattered pieces are gathered.

canonical.definition: Architecture-of-holiness-in-time — Hebrew shabbat (with Heschel's "palace in time") received as cosmic-ordinance; the structural-fact that holiness has temporal-architecture, not only spatial.

bridge.invitation: rest built into the architecture of time
bridge.echo: Rest is part of the architecture, not a reward for finishing.

canonical.gap: offering-peace-as-received-ordinance — the pre-fragmentation root where offering = peace = satisfaction = cosmic-rest; Egyptian htp compresses what modernity split; three-tradition convergence (Egyptian hotep, Hebrew shelamim, Yoruba ebo)
canonical.definition: Offering-peace-as-received-ordinance — the pre-fragmentation understanding that sacrifice IS peace (not sacrifice → peace). Egyptian htp names simultaneously: the offering placed on the altar, the peace that results, the satisfaction of the recipient, the contentment of the giver, and the sun setting at evening. All one word because all one event.

bridge.invitation: peace, satisfaction, offering, and evening held as one event
bridge.echo: Peace is allowed to be the whole event.

canonical.definition: Sympathetic-joy-as-felt-bond — the joy that lights in one heart because another's came true. Gladness at another's good fortune with no admixture of self: no ledger, no mirror. The direct antidote to envy; the only wealth that multiplies by being witnessed.

bridge.invitation: joy that lights because another person's good came true
bridge.echo: Your joy can make mine brighter; no subtraction required.

canonical.definition: The worship-grade joy that arrives when evidence makes truth conclusively visible — received as cosmic-gift, completing in praise.
canonical.pronunciation: /jʊˈreɪ.kə.meɪ/ (yuh-RAY-kuh-meh; 4 syllables; heurēka stress preserved on second syllable; -me as light suffix)

bridge.invitation: joy arriving when evidence makes truth visible
bridge.echo: Evidence gets to throw a tiny joy party when truth becomes visible.

canonical.definition: Divine-play-as-cosmogonic-act, received as ordinance — creation not from necessity, not from lack, not from labor, but from purposeless creative delight. The play-pole of the tapasme-lilame dyad. The universe as the divine's sport: the divine creates because the divine delights to create, and the delight IS the creating.

bridge.invitation: creation arising from delight rather than lack
bridge.echo: Creation is also allowed to be play. The universe survives the silliness.

canonical.definition: Collective divine-human joy-energy as received-ordinance — the state of ecstatic, divinely-energized aliveness that emerges when the sacred and the human genuinely contact each other in communal fullness. Korean *sinmyeong* + Sumerian *me*: the joy you receive when the community and the sacred rise together, not the joy you produce.

bridge.invitation: the aliveness that rises when community and sacred joy meet
bridge.echo: Some joy only arrives when everyone rises together.

canonical.gap: the sudden joyous turn at the darkest point of a story — the rescue no one earned and no one could have written; grace arriving as an event in the narrative, unearned by the characters yet not arbitrary because the story's deepest grain allowed it
canonical.definition: The sudden joyous turn at the darkest point of a story — the rescue no one earned and no one could have written; grace arriving as an event in the narrative, unearned by the characters yet not arbitrary, because the story's deepest grain allowed it.

bridge.invitation: the unearned joyous turn at a story's darkest point
bridge.echo: The dark turn is not promised the last word.
